name: venn
description: Keep private notes about people you know, find shared interests, and plan time together.

interface.shortDescription: Keep private notes about people you know and plan time together.
interface.longDescription: Venn keeps a private, user-approved memory of what matters to you and the people you already know, friends and colleagues alike. Set up in three steps: choose memories to import, review contacts from Instagram or LinkedIn, then find people with similar interests. See which interests matched and why. Then get ideas for time together, a brief before you meet, nudges when it has been a while, and a quiz on how well you know your friends. Nothing is saved without your approval, and Venn never contacts anyone on your behalf.
defaultPrompt: What should I do this week?
